data.name: Barja
data.gender_notes: Barja is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Barja is a Persian name derived from the word 'barj', which means 'exalted' or 'noble'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name evokes feelings of dignity, grace, and respect. The name Barja carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Barja usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of nobility and virtue in the heart of the believer
data.etymology: Barja belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barja total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: برجہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: برجہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ستارہ یا شعاع، اور یہ برج سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے برق یا نور، اور اس نام کی اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت ہے

in_hindi.name: बर्जा
